pages.title: Making Amordrine
pages.text: Make this alloy in an Alloyer:$(br2)1 Kalendrite + 1 Platinum = 2 Amordrine

pages.title: Alloying Notes
pages.text: Supply furnace fuel and the complete ingredient amounts. Most alloy inputs accept ingots or dusts; the Angmallen fallback uses matching forms. Loaded recipes can change these stock equations.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 832 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 4.$(br)Mining efficiency: 11.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 4.0.$(br)Enchantability: 40.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 3, chestplate 5, leggings 4, boots 3.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 2.0.$(br)Enchantability: 40.

pages.title: Armor: Sky-High
pages.text: Grants extra jumps (from 1 to 4) depending on how many armor pieces the player is wearing

pages.title: Equipment: Soulbound
pages.text: This item will persist in your inventory after death

pages.title: Weapon: Divine Grace
pages.text: Bonus Damage depending on target's health, the less health target has the more damage the weapon does (up to 200% damage boost) Only a direct melee attack qualifies; arrows, projectiles, and spells do not inherit this bonus from a held weapon.
